text:
sara: Heads up — we've had a couple of model-serving streams drop in prod-us-west during large checkpoint pushes, looks like grpc streams reset mid-upload. Anyone else seeing this?

mike: yep, caught one earlier: client log shows `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing` then server shows `sendmsg: Message too long` right before the restart.

anil: that `Message too long` screams MTU/GSO mismatch. Which MTU are nodes advertising? overlay? host?

sara: quick checks: node-a (gpu-pool-1) reports `ip link` mtu 9000, node-b (gpu-pool-2) mtu 1500. Both in same k8s AZ, same subnet. CNI is geneve on top of hosts.

jules: interesting — if host interface is 9000 but the underlay path clamps to 1500 we can get fragmentation/GSO oddities. For large gRPC chunks the kernel may try GSO which gets dropped on egress -> `Message too long`.

mike: I ran `tracepath` between those nodes and saw PMTU drop to 1500 unexpectedly on one hop (uplink switch in that rack).

ops-bot: deploy-bot detected 12 stream resets in the last 6 minutes from svc/model-store across node-b pods.

anil: quick triage steps: 1) `ip link show` on both ends; 2) `ethtool -k <iface>` to see GSO/GRO/TX offloads; 3) `sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing` and `ip route get` to test PMTU.

sara: pasted outputs: ```
# on node-a
ip link show ens5 mtu 9000
ethtool -k ens5 | grep gso
        tcp-segmentation-offload: on

# on node-b
ip link show eth0 mtu 1500
ethtool -k eth0 | grep gso
        tcp-segmentation-offload: on
```

jules: so node-b is clamped to 1500 on host, node-a is 9000 -> geneve encapsulation adds ~50 bytes, so some packets exceed path MTU and get silently dropped. gRPC streaming with large frames (model checkpointing, tensor blobs) will trigger fragmentation and tight timing -> stalls/resets.

mike: We also have RoCE-enabled RDMA on some nodes (mlx5). Any chance RDMA traffic influenced offload behavior? I saw ML nodes with `mlx5_core` complaining about MTU mismatch in dmesg earlier.

anil: RDMA can bypass kernel in places and expects MTU consistency. If RoCE path MTU differs between switches you get packet loss. Check `ibv_devinfo` and `rdma link` states.

sara: Workaround candidate: enable TCP MTU probing on affected nodes: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` and set CNI tunnel_mtu to 1450 to be safe.

jules: for a longer fix we should standardize host MTU across the AZ and set calico/geneve/eni tunnel_mtu explicitly in our CNI daemonset (avoid default). Also add a node e2e check in kubelet to fail-fast if host mtu != expected.

mike: quick one-off I tested: disabled GSO on node-a `ethtool -K ens5 gso off tso off` and the stream stopped resetting for that upload. So GSO+PMTU mismatch plays a role.

ops-bot: note added to incident tracker: INC-2026-231, tagging networking and gpu-fleet.

sara: plan: 1) enable tcp_mtu_probing=1 cluster-wide tonight; 2) ramp CNI tunnel_mtu to 1450 on a small canary pool; 3) create remediation playbook with commands we ran. Anyone object?

anil: +1. Also add RDMA health check (ibv_devinfo) to our gpu node bootstrap so misconfigured switches show up during provisioning.

jules: I'll open a PR to add `networking/mtu-check` preflight and update the kube-proxy docs to mention tunnel mtu.

mike: leaving a snip of useful commands for the playbook: ```
# find mismatched MTU
for n in $(nodes); do echo $n; ssh $n "ip link show | grep mtu"; done
# test PMTU
tracepath <peer-ip>
# dump kernel logs for offload issues
journalctl -k | grep -i mlx5
# disable offloads temporarily
ethtool -K <iface> gso off tso off gro off
```

sara: thanks — rolling the probing flag now to canary pool, will post results in 15m :eyes:

deploy-bot: probe-update: tcp_mtu_probing=1 applied to canary nodes (gpu-canary-01..03). Monitoring streams for 30m.

sara: update 20m: canary looks good, no stream resets during a ~5GB checkpoint push. Rolling to rest of gpu-pool-1 after approvals.

mike: filing followup to standardize MTU at provisioning and to add alert when a node reports host MTU != expected.

jules: thx all, adding retrospec notes to incident doc.
